name: G R Infraprojects Limited
summary: A highway builder from Rajasthan that constructs expressway and national highway packages across India.
about: GR Infraprojects is one of the contractors that big Indian expressways are routinely divided among. It builds and, on some projects, holds roads under concession, and it makes many of its own inputs — bitumen mixes, road markings and fabrication — which is unusual among Indian road builders and helps it keep to schedule.
facts: Builds expressway and national highway packages across several states.
Makes many of its own construction inputs rather than buying them in.
Also holds some road projects under long-term concessions.
